wwo.name: Manchester
wwo.method: Ancoats links via New Cross to the Smithfield market and via Oldham Street to Market Street and the Royal Exchange. The Goad and Ordnance Survey plans continue along Deansgate to the Castlefield canal and rail interchange. The Oxford Road and Wilmslow Road corridor continues via Owens College and Rusholme to Platt Hall and Platt Brook. The mapped Platt estate marks the land-use transition. Survey windows are data limits. Salford is independent.

registration.reference: Four approximate Historic England grid controls. Similarity in British National Grid, converted to CRS84.

goad_key_plan.reference: Five approximate Historic England National Grid references. Affine fit of the 960-pixel locator.

castlefield_1896.reference: British National Grid similarity fit of five approximate listed controls in the CIV.SW Deansgate window.

controls.name: Knott Mill Bridge near boundary stone, NHLE 1282975

castlefield_1896.commercial_street_figure_control: Report Figure 8 aligned to section 4 site 28 NGR SJ8343997429 and plot dimensions. The figure is an enlargement. No parcel survey accuracy asserted.

oxford_rusholme.reference: Oxford Road is matched across CIV.SW and CIV.SE at the same map neatline and from CIV.SE to CIV.15 by the mapped road and Owens College cross-street pattern. The 1:2,500 CIV.15 fit uses the approximate listed college location and its common roadway with CXI.NE, which is anchored by Platt Hall and Holy Trinity Church. The six-inch placements are indicative.

smithfield_west.reference: The paired 1891 CIV.NE and 1894 CIV.NW six-inch sheets identify Swan Street across the common neatline. Fit uses the approximate south frame corner, Cathedral and listed western fish-market front.
smithfield_west.source_limit: The first-edition 25-inch CIV.6 was catalogued at Manchester. The accessible six-inch sheet gives the approximate western market extent. Internal market service lanes await readable detailed mapping.
